description: This file defines the EmpDependent entity class for the OrangeHRM system, representing a dependent (such as a child or other relative) associated with an employee. It includes properties like name, relationship type, relationship description, date of birth, and references to the Employee it belongs to. It also contains validation logic for relationship types and uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping.

classes.name: EmpDependent
classes.description: Entity class representing an employee dependent with properties such as name, relationship type, and date of birth, linked to an Employee entity. Provides getter and setter methods for its properties and includes validation for relationship type.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee associated with this dependent.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the Employee associated with this dependent.

methods.name: getSeqNo
methods.description: Returns the sequence number of the dependent record.

methods.name: setSeqNo
methods.description: Sets the sequence number of the dependent record.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the dependent.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the dependent.

methods.name: setRelationshipType
methods.description: Sets the relationship type, validating against allowed types.

methods.name: getDateOfBirth
methods.description: Returns the date of birth of the dependent.

methods.name: setDateOfBirth
methods.description: Sets the date of birth of the dependent.
